Pat Newell must be congratulated on his fine solo effort; he ran comfortably throughout and was at no time fully extended. Bob Glover ran in this event for the first time last March when he returned a time of 30.35.

Despite the brisk start up a half-mile incline, John Moore wasn't satisfied with the pace and, accompanied by Bob Glover and J. Lyne of S.L.H.(2nd claim Kent A.C.), forged ahead to establish a clear lead of thirty yards after 1¼ miles.

A real robust job - The Land Glover - delicate handling is required to bring up to scratch but once under way a true Champion. Fuel consumption is apt to be high but it will burn anything particularly good on nuts and chocolate.
